assets.prompt: The party altar: a broad eight-sided slab, its rim lit on the left and back, its front's thickness in shadow, carved lines joining five set ice-stones; at its back a short plinth with a crystal floating over it, motes of light round it. (96x96 units). Drawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world unit, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down pixel game, about its 1x silhouette, size and frames, part by part, each a rod, a ball, a bevelled box or polygon, a column or a ring: lit from the top-left in three shades of its material, the base the most, with its material's surface where it has one (wood grain and boards, bone pores, worn stone, a flame's bright core, rivets, a glint in the material's own light shade), a dark seam where a part lies over another and a one-pixel dark outline round the outside. Palette colours from docs/STYLE.md only; no player colours; every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
